purpose: An empty opportunity registry to start from. Copy this somewhere outside the repository, point --registry at your copy, and let discovery fill it. It is content data rather than planning material: version it beside the content it governs, because a list the builder cannot see cannot drive a build.
usageRules: Discovery inputs only. Never copy course outlines, lesson sequences, exercises, assessment items, artwork, branding, or proprietary teaching structure from any watched service.
Every delivered item needs original instruction, primary-source evidence, accessibility assets, and a named freshness owner.
A watch-list entry is evidence of market demand and topic vocabulary. It is never a content source.
A rejected entry stays rejected. No later run may propose it again.

coverageBaseline.note: Replace with your own measurement. Until discovery runs, nothing here has been measured.

watchList.label: Replace this with a real catalogue page you want to measure demand against
watchList.note: The watch list is what discovery surveys for DEMAND. Entries are evidence that a topic is taught in the market. They are never a content source. Expect some sites to refuse automated access; discovery names the ones it could not reach on every run.
